source.title: Nonlinear SPDEs and Maximal Regularity: An Extended Survey

outcomes.B19: Proved a restricted order-minus-one Koch-Tataru/VMO endpoint theorem for nonzero constant transport on R^3 with g=0, via exact Brownian translation and deterministic anisotropic Navier-Stokes.
outcomes.B14: Proved that exact componentwise coordinate conjugation preserving the Euclidean Laplacian and incompressibility forces translations, so constant transport is the maximal exact-translation regime.
outcomes.B2: Tested a smooth nonconstant shear transport by an exact first stochastic Picard sideband computation; no supercritical amplification occurs, only critical scaling.

source_status: No source-matching arbitrary-smooth-coefficient endpoint resolution found in bounded literature check through 2026-09-17; negative search is not a novelty certificate.
next_obligation: Treat genuinely spatially varying smooth transport. Preferred next special case: finite commuting divergence-free transport fields or one nonconstant shear, using stochastic-flow transformed random operators plus pathwise Koch-Tataru/tent-space estimates.
